title: Cosmic Scum
definition: The Cosmic Scum is the visible tracer of invisible currents and collisions in the universe, forming as a residue of cosmic forces interacting.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine the Cosmic Scum as the frothy residue left behind when big cosmic waves crash together. It's not a living thing, but rather the leftover trace of these powerful collisions.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The Cosmic Scum is analogous to the foam on the beach or the bubbles in the sea. It's the aggregated byproduct of cosmic forces, marking the boundaries between cosmic structures.
difficulty_levels.expert: The Cosmic Scum is a novel interpretation of the underlying nature of the universe's large-scale structure. It challenges the traditional view of the cosmic web as a living network, positioning it instead as an emergent byproduct. This insight has connections to fields like complex systems and non-equilibrium thermodynamics.

extra_fields.insight: The Cosmic Scum is a powerful and accurate representation of the large-scale structure of the universe, challenging the traditional view of the cosmic web as a living network.
